standard_prerequisites.name: The Koszul complexes fit into distinguished triangles under multiplication of the exponents, by the More on Algebra Koszul multiplicativity lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the Hom vanishing from the Koszul complex K to all its powers K_e.

standard_prerequisites.name: For an object supported on the closed complement of U, its cohomology classes on X are represented by maps from the powers of the Koszul complex, by the represent-cohomology-class lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the Hom vanishing into vanishing of H^n(X, N) for n <= a.

standard_prerequisites.name: An object of D_QCoh on an affine scheme is determined by the complex of modules of its global derived sections
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the vanishing of cohomology with the vanishing of the truncation of N.

core_obligations: Form the cone triangle E -> Rj_*(E|_U) -> N -> E[1]; condition (1) is equivalent to tau_{<= a}N = 0 in the appropriate range: (1) implies tau_{<= a-1}N = 0 and is implied by tau_{<= a}N = 0 (proof lines 10644-10647).
Since K|_U = 0, adjunction gives Hom(K[-n], Rj_*(E|_U)) = Hom(K|_U[-n], E) = 0 for all n, so condition (2) is equivalent to Hom(K[-n], N) = 0 for all n <= a (proof lines 10648-10653).

By the multiplicativity triangles of Koszul complexes the Hom vanishing for K is equivalent to that for all powers K_e; since N|_U = 0, the represent-cohomology-class lemma turns the vanishing of Hom(K_e[-n], N) into the vanishing of H^n(X, N) for n <= a; by the affine comparison this is exactly tau_{<= a}N = 0, completing the circle of equivalences (proof lines 10653-10669).
proof_roadmap: Set up the cone triangle and restate (1) as a truncation condition on N (proof lines 10644-10647).
Use K|_U = 0 to move condition (2) from E to the cone N (proof lines 10648-10653).
Pass to the powers K_e, convert Hom vanishing to cohomology vanishing, and conclude via the affine comparison (proof lines 10653-10669).
